abstract: From January 1, 1970 to July 1, 1976, 128 women had hydatidiform moles evacuated at the Los Angeles County-University of Southern California Women's Hospitals. Of the 121 patients with follow-up, persistent trophoblastic disease (TD) was diagnosed in 32 (26.4 per cent). Remission was achieved in all treated patients. The frequency of TD was significantly increased in pregnancies large for dates (47.8 per cent), with a uterus greater than 20 weeks' gestational size (45.0 per cent) or with theca-lutein cysts greater than 5 cm. in diameter (50.0 per cent). A normal regression curve for serum beta-human gonadotropin as measured by radioimmunoassay has been constructed as an aid to the early recognition of postmolar TD (invasive mole and choriocarcinoma).
abstract_ja: 1970年1月1日から1976年7月1日までに、ロサンゼルス郡・南カリフォルニア大学女性病院で128例の女性が胞状奇胎を娩出した。フォローアップのあった121例のうち32例（26.4%）に持続性栄養膜疾患（TD）が診断された。全治療例で寛解が得られた。TDの頻度は、妊娠月数に比べて大きい妊娠（47.8%）、妊娠20週相当以上の子宮（45.0%）、直径5cmを超える黄体嚢胞を伴う妊娠（50.0%）で有意に高かった。ラジオイムノアッセイで測定した血清βヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピンの正常回帰曲線を作成し、奇胎後の持続性栄養膜疾患（侵入奇胎および絨毛癌を含む）の早期認識に役立てている。
